page_title: BIL 1-0 VAL | Athletic Bilbao v Valencia 28/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Calf Injury

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Tempers flare after Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
90+3' The total number of attempts is 11:1.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Hugo Duro and he is replaced by Dani Gomez (Valencia).
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thierry Correia (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Jesus Vazquez can be given a rest.
89' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
86' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

83' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
82' A substitution has been made. Diego Lopez is replaced by Martin Tejon (Valencia).
82' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Guerra (Valencia) replacing Pepelu.
81' The ratio of the ball possession is 52:48.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Adama Boiro will be replaced by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
79' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
75' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
72' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
71' It is time for a substitution. Javier Marton (Ath Bilbao) is on for Benat Prados Diaz.
70' Here comes a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is given a rest as he is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
70' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Oihan Sancet will be replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
70' It seemed like Luis Rioja (Valencia) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Andre Almeida (Valencia), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
64' A cross into the box from Pepelu (Valencia) is cleared.
63' Julen Agirrezabala leaps to intercept the corner kick from Luis Rioja (Valencia).
63' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.

61' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
59' Here is a change. Rafa Mir is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Andre Almeida (Valencia).
58' The substitution is prepared. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Djalo.
58' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao). Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
55' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
54' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) trips an opposition player and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a foul.
53' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' A pass by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
47' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 1 - 0 It's in! Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the bottom left corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Oscar de Marcos. 1:0.
44' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
43' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
40' Luis Rioja (Valencia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
38' 6:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
35' Pepelu (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
35' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

33' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
32' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle.
29' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
26' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
23' Rafa Mir (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
22' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
22' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.

21' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a stunning save! The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
18' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

18' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Ath Bilbao are taking a throw-in.
16' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
13' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!
12' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

10' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a throw-in.
8' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao).
7' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. Valencia will have an opportunity.
7' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul after Hugo Duro (Valencia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' A long ball forward to Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted.
4' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
1' The game is interrupted now, Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
